definition_used: One or more authors misunderstood one or more parts of a message sent to and/or from one or more authors.
caution: The definition describes a communication misunderstanding without specifying any impact on research content, authorship, editorial processes, or post-publication oversight. It is a status/notice term indicating opacity about the underlying issue, not a substantive integrity breach.
semantic_rationale: The definition refers to a misunderstanding in author communication, which does not inherently imply problems with research reliability, attribution, editorial governance, or post-publication processes. It signals notice opacity about the actual cause, making it ambiguous for manuscript-facing categories.
